newsitem.title: FRANCE: Pernod to sell Suez stake.
newsitem.headline: Pernod to sell Suez stake.

text.p: Pernod Ricard will sell its holding in Cie de Suez as market conditions allow, chairman of the French drinks group Patrick Ricard said on Tuesday.
"Pernod Ricard holds 850,000 Suez shares. They are not destined to remain in our portfolio," Ricard told the annual shareholders meeting.
"We will sell this stake according to market conditions," a company executive said on the margins of the meeting.
Pernod entered Suez' group of stable shareholders when it was privatised at 331 francs per share. Suez was trading at 288 francs per share, up 1.05 percent, at 1300 GMT.
